subject: SUM clause
notes: kb/Work PB1296 (with PB1130): the counter is moved to its printable item unless its size error indicator is set, when EC-REPORT-SUM-SIZE is raised and the item is spaces. The capacity the indicator is set against is GR1s digit count PER CATEGORY (SumCounterDigits): ZZ9 / Z(3) / $$$9 are three digits, 9,999 four, X(4) four, XXBX three; 99 overflows at 120 and prints spaces.
